## API calls
Importing 2022 data (training data)
```{python}
#| echo: false
# ESPN API configuration
BASE_URL = "https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/"

# Extract NFL 2022 season games
games = []
url = f"{BASE_URL}scoreboard"

params = {
    "limit": 1000,
    "dates": 2022
}

response = requests.get(url, params = params)

data = response.json()

for event in data["events"]:
    teams = event["competitions"][0]["competitors"]

    home_team=""
    away_team=""

    for team in teams:
        if team["homeAway"] == "home":
            home_team = team["team"]["id"]
        else:
            away_team = team["team"]["id"]

    games.append({
        "id": event['id'],
        "name": event["name"],
        "home_team": home_team,
        "away_team": away_team,
        "date": event["date"]
    })

df_games_2022 = pd.DataFrame(games)
```

## Data Cleaning & Wrangling

```{python}
train_data = pd.read_csv("data/nfl_plays_2022.csv")
test_data = pd.read_csv("data/nfl_plays_2023.csv")

df_games_2022["id"] = df_games_2022["id"].astype(str)
df_games_2023["id"] = df_games_2023["id"].astype(str)

train_data["gid"] = train_data["gid"].astype(str)
test_data["gid"] = test_data["gid"].astype(str)

df_games_2022 = df_games_2022[df_games_2022["id"].isin(set(train_data["gid"]))]
df_games_2023 = df_games_2023[df_games_2023["id"].isin(set(test_data["gid"]))]
```

## Feature Engineering
```{python}
#| echo: false
#Feature Engineering
#Adding variable of time remaning in game instead of in quarter
train_data["gametime_remaining"] = np.where(train_data['quarter']<=4, (4-train_data['quarter'])*900 + train_data['time_remaining'], np.nan)

#Adding Score Difference relative to home team
train_data["score_diff"] = (train_data["home_score"] - train_data['away_score'])

#train_data.info()
#train_data.describe()
```

```{python}
train_data["offense_team"] = train_data["offense_team"].astype(int).astype(str)
train_data["defense_team"] = train_data["defense_team"].astype(int).astype(str)

#group train data by game id and take the maximum home team's score and away's team score
win_or_lose_2022 = train_data.groupby("gid").agg({"home_score":"max", "away_score":"max"}).reset_index()
# 1 indicates home team scores higher and 0 otherwise
win_or_lose_2022["home_wins"] = (win_or_lose_2022["home_score"] > win_or_lose_2022["away_score"]).astype(int) 

win_or_lose_2022 = win_or_lose_2022.merge(df_games_2022[["id", "home_team", "away_team"]], left_on ="gid", right_on="id")

train_data = train_data.merge(win_or_lose_2022[["gid", "home_wins"]], on="gid")

games_outcome_2022 =[]
for _, row in win_or_lose_2022.iterrows():
    if row["home_wins"] == 1:
        games_outcome_2022.append((row["home_team"], 1))
        games_outcome_2022.append((row["away_team"], 0))
    else:
        games_outcome_2022.append((row["home_team"], 0))
        games_outcome_2022.append((row["away_team"], 1))

games_outcome_2022_df = pd.DataFrame(games_outcome_2022, columns=['team', 'win'])

team_strength = games_outcome_2022_df.groupby("team")["win"].mean().reset_index()

train_data = train_data.merge(team_strength, left_on="offense_team", right_on="team", how = "left").rename(columns={"win": "offense_strength"}).drop(columns=["team"])

train_data = train_data.merge(team_strength, left_on="defense_team", right_on="team", how = "left").rename(columns={"win": "defense_strength"}).drop(columns=["team"])
```


## Feature Engineering
```{python}
#| echo: false
#Feature Engineering
#Adding variable of time remaning in game instead of in quarter
test_data["gametime_remaining"] = np.where(test_data['quarter']<=4, (4-test_data['quarter'])*900 + test_data['time_remaining'], np.nan)

#Adding Score Difference relative to home team
test_data["score_diff"] = (test_data["home_score"] - test_data['away_score'])

#test_data.info()
#test_data.describe()
```

```{python}

test_data["offense_team"] = test_data["offense_team"].astype(int).astype(str)
test_data["defense_team"] = test_data["defense_team"].astype(int).astype(str)

#group train data by game id and take the maximum home team's score and away's team score
win_or_lose_2023 = test_data.groupby("gid").agg({"home_score":"max", "away_score":"max"}).reset_index()
# 1 indicates home team scores higher and 0 otherwise
win_or_lose_2023["home_wins"] = (win_or_lose_2023["home_score"] > win_or_lose_2023["away_score"]).astype(int) 

win_or_lose_2023 = win_or_lose_2023.merge(df_games_2023[["id", "home_team", "away_team"]], left_on ="gid", right_on="id")

test_data = test_data.merge(win_or_lose_2023[["gid", "home_wins"]], on="gid")

test_data = test_data.merge(team_strength, left_on="offense_team", right_on="team", how = "left").rename(columns={"win": "offense_strength"}).drop(columns=["team"])

test_data = test_data.merge(team_strength, left_on="defense_team", right_on="team", how = "left").rename(columns={"win": "defense_strength"}).drop(columns=["team"])
```

### MODELS
```{python}
features = ['gametime_remaining',"quarter", 'down', 'yards_to_go', "yardsToEndzone", "offense_strength", "defense_strength", "score_diff"]

X_train = train_data[features]
y_train = train_data['home_wins']

X_test = test_data[features]
y_test = test_data["home_wins"]
```

```{python}
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import RandomizedSearchCV

param_grid = {
    "max_features": ['sqrt', 1/3, 0.5],
    "min_samples_leaf" : [1, 5, 10]
}

rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, random_state=65, n_jobs =-1
)
cv_rf = RandomizedSearchCV(
    rf, param_grid, cv=5, n_iter=10, n_jobs=-1,
    scoring="roc_auc"
)

cv_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)
print(f"Best params: "
      f"{cv_rf.best_params_}")

```

```{python}
from xgboost import XGBClassifier

param_dist = {
    'max_depth':     [4,6,8],
    'learning_rate': [0.05, 0.1, 0.5],
    'reg_lambda':    [0.1, 1, 10],
    'reg_alpha':     [0, 0.1, 1],
}

xgb = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, 
    random_state=65,
    n_jobs=-1
 )

xgb_search = RandomizedSearchCV(
    estimator=xgb,
    param_distributions=param_dist,
    n_iter=10 ,  
    cv=5,  
    scoring= 'roc_auc', 
    random_state=65,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=1
 )

xgb_search.fit(X_train, y_train) 

best_params_xgb = xgb_search.best_params_ 
print('Best params:', best_params_xgb)
```


```{python}
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, roc_auc_score, confusion_matrix, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
best_params_rf = cv_rf.best_params_

best_rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    **best_params_rf, n_estimators = 200, random_state=65, n_jobs=-1
)

best_rf.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred_rf = best_rf.predict(X_test)
y_prob_rf = best_rf.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

rf_test_acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_rf)
rf_test_f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred_rf)
rf_test_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob_rf)

print(f"Random Forest test accuracy: {rf_test_acc}")
print(f"Random Forest test F1-score: {rf_test_f1}")
print(f"Random Forest test AUC: {rf_test_auc}")

cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred_rf)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm, display_labels=["Loss", "Win"])
disp.plot(ax=ax, cmap='Blues', xticks_rotation=45)
plt.title("Confusion Matrix - Random Forest Classification")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
rf_importances = best_rf.feature_importances_

imp_df_rf = pd.DataFrame({
    'feature': features,
    'importance': rf_importances
}).sort_values('importance')

(
    ggplot(imp_df_rf, aes(x='feature', y = 'importance')) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip()
)
```

```{python}
best_xgb = XGBClassifier(
    **best_params_xgb, n_estimators = 200, random_state=65, n_jobs=-1
)

best_xgb.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred_xgb = best_xgb.predict(X_test)
y_prob_xgb = best_xgb.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1]

xgb_test_acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred_xgb)
xgb_test_f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred_xgb)
xgb_test_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob_xgb)

print(f"XGBoost test accuracy: {xgb_test_acc}")
print(f"XGBoost test F1-score: {xgb_test_f1}")
print(f"XGBoost test AUC: {xgb_test_auc}")

cm_xgb = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred_xgb)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))
disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm_xgb, display_labels=["Loss", "Win"])
disp.plot(ax=ax, cmap='Blues', xticks_rotation=45)
plt.title("Confusion Matrix - XGBoost Classification")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

comparison_c = pd.DataFrame({
    'Model': ['Random Forest', "XGBoost"],
    'Test Accuracy': [rf_test_acc, xgb_test_acc],
    'Test Misclassification Error': [1-rf_test_acc, 1-xgb_test_acc],

})
